{{Term/Store|Candle|Candles|Series, TAoL, TotK, ZA, HW, HWL, HWDE|plural}} are recurring [[Item]]s and [[Object]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Exp Game|TAoL, TotK, ZA, HWDE}}<ref>{{Cite Book|quote= |book= E |publisher= |page= 119 {{Exp Game|TAoL}}}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|Candle|Game Screen|TotK}}</ref><ref>{{Cite Manual|quote= |game= ZA |page= 4}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|{{Color HWDE|Green|Candle}}: Use this on trees to uncover hidden stairways.|Tutorial|HWDE}}</ref>

==Location and Uses==
==={{TAoL|-}}===
{{Descriptions TAoL}}
In {{TAoL}}, the Candle can be found in the [[Parapa Palace]]<ref>{{Cite|GET CANDLE IN PARAPA PALACE. GO WEST.|Hylian|TAoL}}</ref> after defeating an [[Iron Knuckle]]. It lights up otherwise pitch-black caves and allows Link to see any enemies who may dwell within.<ref>{{Cite Manual|quote= When this is obtained, places that you had not been able to see until now because of the dark are lit up.|game= TAoL|page= 46}}</ref> The Candle is not required to beat the game, but it is more difficult to navigate dark [[Cave]]s without it.

==={{OoT3D|-}}===
{{Stub|OoT3D}}

==={{MM|-}}===
{{Stub|MM3D}}

==={{TMC|-}}===
Candles appear inside [[Minish]]-sized [[House]]s. Link is unable to light them.

==={{TotK|-}}===
{{Stub|TotK}}
Candles are [[Zonai Technology|Zonai Technologies]] found in [[Shrine of Light|Shrines of Light]]. They can be [[Fuse]]d to [[Weapon]]s and [[Shield]]s or attached to other [[Object]]s using [[Ultrahand]].

==Other Appearances==
==={{ZA|-}}===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
{{Descriptions ZA}}
In {{ZA}}, Candles can be purchased from several merchants around [[Tolemac]]for 100 [[Rupee|Rubies]]. They are used to light up dark rooms inside of [[Dungeon]]s, but can only be used once per Candle. As there are not very many dark rooms, the Candle sees little use.
{{Noncanon|End}}

==={{HW|-}}===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
{{Stub|HWDE}}
In {{HW}}, Candles appear as [[Item Card]]s used in [[Adventure Mode]].
{{Noncanon|End}}
